subject: Math
prompt: Each of the following frequency tables represents a data set. Which data set has the greatest mean?
explanation: Choice D is correct. To find the mean, multiply each value by its frequency, add the products, and divide by the total frequency. Choice A: $(15 \cdot 2 + 35 \cdot 2 + 55 \cdot 3 + 75 \cdot 3) \div 10 = 490 \div 10 = 49$. Choice B: $(20 \cdot 3 + 40 \cdot 3 + 50 \cdot 3 + 60 \cdot 3) \div 12 = 510 \div 12 = 42.5$. Choice C: $(20 \cdot 1 + 40 \cdot 2 + 60 \cdot 5) \div 8 = 400 \div 8 = 50$. Choice D: $(20 \cdot 2 + 40 \cdot 2 + 60 \cdot 3 + 70 \cdot 3) \div 10 = 510 \div 10 = 51$. The greatest mean is $51$.
